tools.name: rwa_list_assets
tools.description: List authoritative Robinhood Chain Stock Token assets, optionally filtered by symbol.

tools.name: rwa_analyze_asset
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Direct upstream MCP calls return the canonical SqueezeOS x402 purchase path; they do not expose the complete paid payload for free. Return evidence-backed asset, reference quote, multiplier, corporate-action, and risk flags.

tools.name: rwa_find_opportunities
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Direct upstream MCP calls return the canonical SqueezeOS x402 purchase path; they do not expose the complete paid payload for free. Score a Robinhood Stock Token only from authoritative reference data and supplied venue evidence.

tools.name: rwa_compare_assets
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Direct upstream MCP calls return the canonical SqueezeOS x402 purchase path; they do not expose the complete paid payload for free. Compare two or more Robinhood Stock Tokens using the same evidence-first opportunity engine.

tools.name: rwa_market_snapshot
tools.description: Premium intelligence. Direct upstream MCP calls return the canonical SqueezeOS x402 purchase path; they do not expose the complete paid payload for free. Return a read-only snapshot of active Robinhood Stock Tokens without inventing venue liquidity.

tools.name: prediction_list_markets
tools.description: List event markets observed on Robinhood's public prediction-markets pages. Read-only public evidence; no brokerage access, order placement, or synthetic odds.

tools.name: prediction_get_market
tools.description: Inspect one official Robinhood event page: displayed contracts, cents/percent values, timeline, and resolution description. Values are observations, not SML forecasts.

tools.name: prediction_rank_attention
tools.description: Rank only markets with an explicit public Robinhood volume signal. Returns partial/no rank rather than fabricating attention when volume is absent.
